messages:
incident-bot: Pager — high runtime queue lengths for region-us-west (avg queue depth 980, p95 latency 3.4s). Impacting ~5% of hostnames. Alerting oncall.

alice: Paging in. looking into queue growth and error spikes. grabbing logs.

lee: saw spike ~09:12 UTC, correlates with a burst of embed and long-context chat requests from a single client. possible replay.

alice: Not seeing throttles firing yet. max_inflight currently 1200. p50 ok, p95 climbing. starting short mitigation: lower max_inflight to 700 and enable soft shedding for low-priority paths.

alice: Running command:
```
redwoodctl runtime set-max-inflight --pool=us-west --max=700 --reason="mitigate queue spike"
```

incident-bot: Command accepted. New max_inflight=700 (effective 09:15:12 UTC).

sara: I'm going to enable soft-shedding for low-priority endpoints (/metrics, /health) and tighten free-tier burst tokens. will keep enterprise routes on fallback.

sara: Also preparing a targeted quota bump for enterprise keys through the dedicated pool instead of a global bump.

dan: Heads-up — CS needs to notify affected customers. @emma-cs can you draft a short customer note with the status and mitigation steps?

emma-cs: On it. pulling the impacted list now, will DM for approvals.

lee: Recommend disabling non-critical streaming for new requests — reduces KV cache pressure and tail latency. propose toggling streaming off for new sessions.

alice: Executing feature flag toggle:
`ffctl toggle --env=prod runtime.streaming false --by=alice --ticket=INC-4821`

incident-bot: Feature flag update queued; rollout 10% -> 100% over 2m.

alice: Monitoring — queue depth falling to ~420, p95 down to ~1.1s. still seeing a small tail of long-running requests. will reduce low-priority timeout from 30s -> 20s to shed earlier.

sara: Patch applied to runtime config:
```
/opt/runtime/config.yaml
low_priority_timeout: 20
low_priority_shed: true
```

lee: Also bumping soft rate-limit for enterprise keys to 10 rps per key on the fallback path so SLA customers keep service.

emma-cs: Customer note ready; sending now. CCing @matt-ps for postmortem follow-up.

alice: Ok stabilizing, queue trend looks healthy. keeping page open for 30m then handing off to morning shift. will revert streaming flag after full validation.

matt-ps: Thanks — starting an incident doc. Follow-ups: replay analysis, client-side throttling patterns, and impact of streaming toggle on p95.

emma-cs: Sent notice to 6 customers at 09:28 UTC. got 1 reply asking for ETA on full normalization.

alice: ETA ~30-45m for full normalization, barring secondary spikes. leaving mitigations in place until metrics steady for 15m.

incident-bot: Incident INC-4821 status updated to MONITORING. Last update 09:36:40 UTC.
